Roles and permissions

Staff request assets and record their own handoffs. Coordinators approve reservations, review condition photos and block assets needing service.

Build prompt

Build “Shared Equipment & Vehicle Check-Out Log” on NeoApps for a nonprofit. Track a start and end time, collection site, condition checklist and return photos. Prevent overlapping reservations and hold an item for inspection when damage is reported. Staff request assets and record their own handoffs. Coordinators approve reservations, review condition photos and block assets needing service. Use fictional records for the demo.

Acceptance test

A van booked 09:00–12:00 rejects an overlapping 11:00 pickup. A damaged return puts it on hold. Only the coordinator’s clearance makes it available again.
